bio: Discover the true flavours of Extremadura’s pastures and meadows in this regionally inspired restaurant occupying a 19C building just a few metres from the Plaza Mayor. The focus on the reasonably varied à la carte is predominantly on the stalwarts of Extremadura cuisine (morcilla, local sausages, Iberian pork stew etc), although rice options (for a minimum of two guests) and several cod dishes also make an appearance....
